free_text.inst.v2.D8: Answered strictly from documented public biography, in the first person as Stevland Hardaway Morris (b. Stevland Hardaway Judkins, Saginaw, Michigan, 13 May 1950). Born roughly six weeks premature; retinopathy of prematurity (retrolental fibroplasia), associated with the oxygen given in the incubator, left me blind in infancy. Third of six children of Lula Mae Hardaway; my father, Calvin Judkins, was largely absent after my mother took the children to Detroit around 1954, and I later took my mother's married name, Morris. Signed to Motown (Tamla) in 1961 at eleven; 'Fingertips, Pt. 2' went to No. 1 in August 1963. Graduated from the Michigan School for the Blind in Lansing, 1969. Married Syreeta Wright in September 1970; divorced 1972. Let the Motown contract lapse at 21 in 1971 and re-signed on my own terms, with creative control and my own publishing (Black Bull). Nearly killed in a car accident near Salisbury, North Carolina, on 6 August 1973 - four days in a coma, permanent loss of the sense of smell. First child, Aisha Morris, born February 1975; nine children in all. Long campaign that made Dr. King's birthday a federal holiday (signed 1983). Mother died 31 May 2006. Kidney transplant in December 2019. Later married Kai Millard Morris (2001, divorced) and Tomeeka Robyn Bracy (2017); moved to Ghana and took Ghanaian citizenship. Section D was left unanswered: it asks about a reading I was not shown, and I did not open the verdicts or readings folders.
